summary.text: Suzanne Miles is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 7 who has served since 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Suzanne Miles was born in Owensboro, Kentucky, and earned a degree from Transylvania University.
She took office in the Kentucky House on January 4, 2014.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Committee on Committees, the Natural Resources and Energy Committee, and the Rules Committee.
